_note: Routes are Raider Network editorial guides (demo for v5). Ratings are 1–10 estimates, not game data. POI and item links follow the sources in maps.json / items.json.

routes.name: Assembly Tech Run
routes.summary: A sweep of Stella Montis upper-level Exodus areas aimed at Rotary Encoders, Ion Sputters and Magnetrons.
steps: Enter through the Lobby and check drawers on the way in.
Clear the Assembly floor, then the Assembly Workshops (drawers and cabinets).
Finish in Medical Research — white and yellow drawers, file cabinets.
Extract or reset; avoid lingering where fights draw third parties.

routes.name: Residential Headphone Sweep
routes.summary: Residential and office containers across Buried City for Headphones and general Residential loot.
steps: Finish in the Hospital staff rooms or JKV offices depending on extraction.

routes.name: Matriarch Reactor Hunt
routes.summary: Squad-only hunt for the Matriarch when the condition is active. Drops include the Matriarch Reactor and Magnetic Accelerator.
steps: Only queue when the Matriarch condition is listed for the Dam.
Bring heavy ammo and explosives; coordinate in squad comms.
Loot the drop fast — the fight attracts other squads.

routes.name: Departure Building Run
routes.summary: Short interior run through the Departure Building offices for Headphones and office loot.
steps: Head to the Departure Building west of the Launch Towers.
Upper-floor offices: desk drawers and suitcases.
Extract early — this is a quick loop.
